==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Indefinitely suspended by [[Kingzone DragonX]] in March 2018 for making suicide-related jokes in solo queue prior to joining the team.<ref>[https://twitter.com/KINGZONEDX/status/972085912581505025 Kingzone DragonX's Tweet (Korean)] ''twitter.com''</ref>
** The ban was lifted 4 months later.
* Has lead the LCK in solo kills during the regular season in 5 different splits.
** Tied for first with [[Nuguri]] in Summer of 2019 with 21, Tied for first with [[Canna]] in Summer of 2020 with 31, Tied for first with [[Chovy]] in Spring of 2021 with 24, First in Spring of 2022 with 30, and First in Summer of 2022 with 25
* Nearly broke [[MaRin]]'s record for solo kills, coming in second place in solo kills during the 2022 Spring split.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on July 29, 2022.
** Is the 20th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Kiin]], and [[Aiming]].
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on February 25, 2024, becoming the 13th player to do so.
=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x3 (Spring 2020, Spring 2021, Spring 2022)
* LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x2 (Summer 2020, Summer 2022)
